name: WF-361 — Delivery Confirmation → Seller Response Monitoring / Timeout Activation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first().json||{}; const now=new Date().toISOString(); const dealId=i.deal_id||i.dealId; const leadId=i.lead_id||i.leadId; const propertyId=i.property_id||i.propertyId; const providerMessageId=i.provider_message_id||i.providerMessageId; const status=String(i.status||i.delivery_status||'').toLowerCase(); const dnc=Boolean(i.dnc||i.do_not_contact); const blockers=Array.isArray(i.blockers)?i.blockers:[]; const attempts=Number(i.attempts||0); const maxAttempts=Number(i.max_attempts||5); const timeoutHours=Number(i.response_timeout_hours||24); const deliveredAt=i.delivered_at||i.delivery_timestamp||now; const base=i.idempotency_key||[dealId,leadId,providerMessageId].filter(Boolean).join(':'); let route='monitor'; let reason='delivery_confirmed'; if(dnc){route='human_control';reason='dnc';} else if(blockers.length){route='human_control';reason='blocker';} else if(!dealId||!leadId||!propertyId||!providerMessageId){route='confirmation_reconciliation';reason='missing_identity';} else if(['failed','bounced','rejected','undeliverable'].includes(status)){route='retry_reengagement';reason='delivery_failed';} else if(i.seller_response||i.inbound_message||i.response_text){route='seller_response';reason='seller_response_present';} else if(i.response_timeout_due===true || (i.response_due_at && new Date(i.response_due_at).getTime()<=Date.now())){route='followup_decision';reason='response_timeout_due';} else if(attempts>=maxAttempts){route='human_control';reason='max_attempts';} return [{json:{...i,workflow_id:'WF-361',status:'accepted',route,reason,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,provider_message_id:providerMessageId,delivered_at:deliveredAt,response_timeout_hours:timeoutHours,response_due_at:i.response_due_at||new Date(new Date(deliveredAt).getTime()+timeoutHours*3600000).toISOString(),monitoring_idempotency_key:base+':response-monitor:'+attempts,monitoring_state:route==='monitor'?'waiting_for_seller_response':'not_activated',attempts,max_attempts:maxAttempts,processed_at:now,crm_activity:{type:'communication_response_monitoring',workflow_id:'WF-361',route,reason,provider_message_id:providerMessageId}}}];
